title: Ling-3.0-flash received a dated OpenRouter model reference
summary: On 2026-07-27, the sealed development record linked to OpenRouter's public model page for InclusionAI Ling-3.0-flash. This establishes a dated public reference for the model, but does not establish its launch date, capabilities, or current service availability.
